correctness.rationale: PASS: After factoring z^n, the two analytic rescalings are even Gaussian sums with opposite signs (-1)^j. On compacts, diagonal covariance tends by Riemann sum to 4∫cosh(tw)conj(cosh(tv))dt; off-diagonal alternating sum O(1/n) and zero pseudo-covariance establish independence. Uniform Gaussian moment bounds give compact-open tightness, and Hurwitz/argument principle give zero-count convergence. Independently computed K(w,w)=sinh(2x)/x+sin(2y)/y, Δlog K = (16/45)(x²+y²)+O(|w|⁴) and EN(B_r)=(2/45)r⁴+O(r⁶); finite-n exact moment coefficients converge. Conditioning on independent ξ_n shifts a smooth planar curve away from 0 almost surely, proving no finite-degree unit-circle zeros; reciprocity then pairs inside/outside. Limits require fixed compact w sets, not uniform in growing windows.

A general dependent Gaussian analytic field theorem could subsume formulation, so priority is qualified.
